source.section: Liquidity and Capital Resources — Investing Activities · Six Months Ended July 4, 2026 (YTD)
source.quote: Capital spending was $297 million in the first six months of 2026, as compared to $229 million in the first six months of 2025.

source.section: Note 14, Comprehensive Income and Equity — Common Stock Share Repurchase Program · Six Months Ended July 4, 2026 (YTD)
